Georgia's fixed statewide ABAWD 36-month window (Dec 1, 2023 – Nov 30, 2026) expires — a NEW window begins December 1, 2026 and no regaining is needed once it starts (SNAP Manual §3355). Do not describe the old window after that date.
Georgia had NO ABAWD waivers when this pack was built ('all counties... time-limited', §3355; FNS FY26-Q3) — waiver status is volatile post-OBBBA; re-verify §3355 and the current FNS quarterly file.
